Name: (AT) Ruby's Bedroom
Author: samsomn
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=3]A warm welcome to Ruby's humble abode <3[/size][/color]
This Alternative Textures mod was created based on my alter Ruby! Enjoy <3

[size=4]Not sure how to use this mod?[/size]
[size=3]- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][/size]
- Install this mod!
- Buy paint brush from Robin!
[size=4]- BOOM [/size]RUBY BEDROOM!!!

Don't know what furniture to use the paint brush on? Check out the last image! :D
(To skip that madness, use  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] !! It is not required, but helps a ton!)





A special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Luminte]Luminte[/url] for giving me the OK to use some assets I made for an old mod we made together :) Check its mods out!
